mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_version v JOIN pf.workspace w ON w.id=v.workspace_id AND w.space_id=v.space_id WHERE v.id=CAST(#{file.versionId} AS uuid) AND v.file_id=CAST(#{file.fileId} AS uuid) AND v.workspace_id=CAST(#{file.workspaceId} AS uuid) AND v.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND w.state='READY' AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}))
mapper.sql: e.id AS extraction_id,e.source_kind,e.workspace_id,e.file_id,e.version_id,e.attachment_id,e.source_asset_id,e.source_sha256,e.output_sha256 AS text_sha256,e.name,e.output_object_key AS text_object_key,e.output_bytes AS text_bytes

pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) AND e.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND e.status='READY' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.asset_object o WHERE o.id=e.output_asset_id AND o.space_id=e.space_id AND o.status='AVAILABLE' AND o.sha256=e.output_sha256 AND o.size_bytes=e.output_bytes) AND ((e.source_kind='CHAT_ATTACHMENT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.chat_attachment a WHERE a.id=e.attachment_id AND a.actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND a.space_id=e.space_id AND a.status='AVAILABLE' AND a.asset_id=e.source_asset_id)) OR (e.source_kind='FILE_VERSION' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.file_version v JOIN pf.workspace w ON w.id=v.workspace_id AND w.space_id=v.space_id WHERE v.id=e.version_id AND v.space_id=e.space_id AND v.file_id=e.file_id AND v.asset_id=e.source_asset_id AND w.state='READY')))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pf.document_extraction e WHERE e.id=CAST(#{ref.extractionId} AS uuid) AND e.source_kind=#{ref.kind} AND AND e.file_id=CAST(#{ref.fileId} AS uuid) AND e.version_id=CAST(#{ref.versionId} AS uuid)e.attachment_id=CAST(#{ref.attachmentId} AS uuid)
SELECT request_hash FROM pf.attachment_submission WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND canonical_path=#{path} AND request_id=#{request}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.idempotency_record WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND user_id=#{actor.userId} AND canonical_path=#{path} AND method='POST' AND key=#{request})
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.message SET blocks_json=blocks_json || jsonb_build_array(CAST(#{block} AS jsonb)) WHERE task_id=#{task} AND role='USER'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT FROM pf.task_attachment a JOIN pf.task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN pf.document_extraction e ON e.id=a.extraction_id WHERE t.space_id=#{space} AND t.conversation_id=#{conversation} AND(t.id=#{task} OR t.status='SUCCEEDED')

SELECT pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.task_attachment a JOIN pf.task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN pf.document_extraction e ON e.id=a.extraction_id WHERE t.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND t.conversation_id=#{conversation} AND(t.id=#{task} OR t.status='SUCCEEDED') AND NOT())
